newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stocks end lower amid talk of fund sales.
newsitem.headline: KL stocks end lower amid talk of fund sales.

text.p: Lingering talk of foreign fund sales, possibly by the Japanese, pushed Kuala Lumpur blue chips lower for the second day in a row.

Program selling by foreign funds knocked main liners on Wednesday, and weak sentiment spilled over into today's trading. "News about that only dampened buying sentiment," said a dealer with a bank-linked brokerage.
After failing to break above the even mark, the benchmark Composite Index ended down 2.00 points to 1,138.92. Selling even seeped into the loftier Second Board, which eased 7.47 points to 572.18.
